from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, cv2
from pathlib import Path

block=Path(r'C:\Users\sandro\AppData\Local\Temp\vc-35-cdx-20260911-r02\b01')
def gray(p):
    return np.array(Image.open(p).convert('L'))
def bbox(a, thr=245):
    ys,xs=np.where(a<thr)
    return (int(xs.min()),int(ys.min()),int(xs.max()+1),int(ys.max()+1))
parts=[gray(extra/f'ntc-p64-raster-xref{x}.jpeg') for x in range(1091,1096)]
stitch=np.vstack(parts)
target=gray(block/'img'/'fig-3.5.1-zone-temperatura-mappa.png')
bs=bbox(stitch); bt=bbox(target)
cs=stitch[bs[1]:bs[3],bs[0]:bs[2]]
ct=target[bt[1]:bt[3],bt[0]:bt[2]]
rs=cv2.resize(cs,(ct.shape[1],ct.shape[0]),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
# correlate ink intensity after centering
x=(255-rs).astype(np.float64).ravel(); y=(255-ct).astype(np.float64).ravel()
corr=float(np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1]); mae=float(np.mean(np.abs(rs.astype(np.int16)-ct.astype(np.int16))))

print('aligned_gray_corr', round(corr,6), 'aligned_mae_0_255', round(mae,3))

for i in range(4):
    upper=parts[i][-1,:].astype(np.int16); lower=parts[i+1][0,:].astype(np.int16)
    print('seam',i+1,'mean_abs_boundary_delta',round(float(np.mean(np.abs(upper-lower))),3))
